title: The Human Body — Fearfully and Wonderfully Made
description: Test your knowledge of the amazing body systems God designed!

questions.question: How many bones are in the adult human body?
questions.explanation: The adult human body has 206 bones that work together to provide structure, protection, and movement — all carefully designed by God.

questions.question: Which type of muscle is found only in the heart?
questions.explanation: Cardiac muscle is found only in the heart. God designed it to beat non-stop for your entire life without you ever having to think about it.

questions.question: What protects the stomach from being dissolved by its own acid?
questions.explanation: God designed a special mucus lining that protects the stomach wall from its own powerful digestive acids — an example of brilliant, purposeful design.

questions.question: About how many times does the heart beat each day?
questions.explanation: Your heart beats about 100,000 times every day, pumping blood to all 37 trillion cells in your body. Only God could design such a tireless organ.

questions.question: What are the tiny air sacs in the lungs where gas exchange occurs?
questions.explanation: Alveoli are tiny air sacs in the lungs — about 600 million of them — where oxygen enters the blood and carbon dioxide is removed. God designed this enormous surface area for maximum efficiency.

questions.question: About how many neurons (nerve cells) are in the human brain?
questions.explanation: The human brain contains about 86 billion neurons with trillions of connections — more complex than any computer, pointing to an intelligent Creator.

questions.question: Which Bible verse says 'the life of a creature is in the blood'?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 17:11 declares that 'the life of a creature is in the blood' — a truth God revealed thousands of years before modern science confirmed how blood sustains life.

questions.question: What does Psalm 139:14 tell us about how we are made?
options: We are fearfully and wonderfully made
We are no different from animals
questions.explanation: Psalm 139:14 declares that we are 'fearfully and wonderfully made,' meaning God created us with incredible care, purpose, and design.
